title: 19-BCV-014(REV1) - 12-storey encapsulated mass timber construction
code_edition: National Building Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)); National Fire Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NFC(AE)); conditions based on NBCC/NFCC 2020

facts.text: The revision permits encapsulated mass-timber construction up to 12 storeys as an alternative solution to the 2019 Alberta building and fire codes.
The source says its conditions are based on the 2020 National Building and Fire Codes and include additional construction-phase fire-protection and ongoing-maintenance conditions.
The operative condition permits buildings or parts up to 12 storeys if design and construction comply with NBCC 2020 and NFCC 2020.
facts.locator: Same PDF, p. 2, Application and Variance
